home_sligo_nana.text: Sit down, sit down. The kettle has already forgiven me for being late.
Round here you do not complain, you 'give out'. I have given out about the weather since 1971.
Brocklings come into the garden at night. Keep the bins shut and we get along very well.

then.text: You have had your slice. The ring is still out there, somewhere.

else.text: I baked a barmbrack. There is a ring hidden inside, and whoever finds it gets a year of luck. Take a slice.
